name: Sofafin
subtitle: Your Jellyfin, from the couch
privacyPolicyText:
SOFAFIN — PRIVACY POLICY

IN SHORT
Sofafin does not collect, store, sell or share any personal data.

DATA WE COLLECT
None. The app contains no analytics, no advertising networks and no tracking SDKs.

YOUR SERVER, YOUR DATA
Everything Sofafin displays comes from the Jellyfin server you connect to and host yourself. The app reads your library from it and writes your playback progress back to it. Neither the developer nor any third party has access to that server.

DATA KEPT ON YOUR APPLE TV
— your session: server address, user identifier and access token, stored in the device keychain;
— your preferences: last open tab, interface language, recent searches;
— an image cache, so artwork is not downloaded again and again.
This data never leaves the device and is removed when the app is uninstalled.

NETWORK CONNECTIONS
The app connects only to the address you enter. It makes no other request.

CHILDREN
Sofafin is not directed at children and collects no data about them.

CHANGES
Any change to this policy is dated on the published page at https://maximesaltet.com/sofafin/privacy
